DESCRIPTION: This screenshot shows the ElevenLabs admin dashboard sidebar for a specific "Support agent" configuration. The UI displays a dark-themed navigation menu organized into sections: Overview (Spotlight, Dashboards, Architect), Configure (Agent, Procedures, Workflow, Branches, Knowledge Base, Analysis, Tools, Guardrails, Settings), and Monitor (Conversations, Tests, Users), with a version selector showing "Main" at the top.
